RUNLOG

Your running, at a glance: fitness, race estimates, volume and consistency, from your own runs.

Load your running history

Upload one file with your past runs. RunLog reads it on this device; your runs never leave it. No account, nothing to pay.

Strava or Garmin export (.zip, exactly as downloaded) or a spreadsheet (.xlsx). Pick the one that has your runs:

From Strava (works for most watches that sync to Strava)
  1. On a computer, open strava.com/account and sign in.
  2. Under Download your account, click Get Started, then Request download.
  3. Strava emails a download link, usually within a few hours. Check the email address on your Strava profile.
  4. Download the zip and upload it here as it is. No need to unzip it.
From Garmin Connect
  1. On a computer, open garmin.com/account/datamanagement and sign in.
  2. Click Export Your Data, then Request Data Export.
  3. Garmin emails a link, usually within 1–2 days (longer for big accounts). The link expires, so download it soon.
  4. Upload the zip here as it is. It can be large; only the activity list inside is read.
From a spreadsheet
  1. Download the template (Excel).
  2. Open it and read the Start here tab. On the Run Log tab, type one row per run: date, distance and time. Pace and run type fill themselves in; pick Race under Your Type for races.
  3. Optional: gym sessions on Strength Log, breaks on Rest Log, a plan you follow on Training Plan, and your next race in the box beside the Run Log.
  4. Save it and upload it here.
Or paste from a spreadsheet instead

In your spreadsheet's Run Log tab, select the header row and everything below it, copy (Ctrl/Cmd+C) and paste it here.

Data is stored in this browser only. When you upload again, you choose whether the file adds to your data or replaces it. A file from Download my data brings everything back, in this or a later RunLog.

Delete everything? This can't be undone.

This removes from this browser: every run, gym session and walk, your rest periods, your race goal, your training plan, every change you made in the Log, sessions you logged here, your watch readings and your settings.

Your files, Strava and Garmin are not touched. To use the dashboard again you'll have to upload your file again, and anything you only added or tagged here is gone for good.
